videos.title: Tabula Rasa: End of Eloh Vale
videos.reviewMethod: yt-dlp download (formats 243+251, 480x360, 25 fps, best available); ffmpeg scene-change detection plus manual crops of chat/tracker/hospital text. Client cross-check against the selected 1.16.5.0 client's decoded tables (gamecontext.pyo, gamecontextlanguage.pyo, maptemplate.pyo, uielementlanguage.pyo, graveyardlanguage.pyo, playermessagelanguage.pyo). Trimmed from /home/blizz/backups/rasa-net/research/20260926-end-of-eloh-vale/events.json (17 events) to the rows load-bearing for final-live preservation.

observations.text: Squad of four (levels 20-28) runs a map region-labelled 'Eloh Bridge' -> 'Eloh Shield Gate' -> 'Eloh Cave' -> 'Eloh Sanctuary'. Client cross-check: maptemplate.pyo[1555] = adv_foreas_concordia_divide_elohvale, and gamecontextlanguage.pyo[1398] = 'Eloh Vale (OLD)' with no row 1398 in the final client's gamecontext.pyo — this map and context are retired.
observations.limit: Squad member levels read from blurred 480x360 digits; could be off by a similar-looking digit. Player names are not preserved content.

observations.text: '/rave' typed in Squad chat; the emote result line 'You swing your glow sticks for all to see. The music, she will set you free. ' is a byte-identical match (plus trailing space) to the final 1.16.5.0 client's playermessagelanguage 976.
observations.limit: No character animation for the emote is clearly visible in third-person view.

observations.text: Player dies falling into a whirlpool; the Hospital Selection window lists group 'Eloh Vale' with 'AFS Medical', 'gy_eloh_vale', 'gy_pyramid' — raw, untranslated internal graveyard names. The final client's graveyardlanguage.pyo has no 'gy_eloh_vale'/'gy_pyramid' rows; the final Eloh Vale (gamecontext 2084) instead has graveyard 279 'Hospital: Forean Pyramid' and 280 'Forward Recon Medic'.
observations.limit: Video ends at 204.0 s before a hospital is chosen. This confirms the obsolete map's graveyard naming was replaced, not what the rebuilt map's own spawn/reward layout should be.
